Name: Secondary Targeting Information
Description: The SECTGA TRE contains a list of secondary targets tasked in the original collection. This TRE may not be present in a derived image. Target information in exploited/derived imagery is contained in PIATG.

SEC_ID.Name: Designator of Secondary Target
SEC_ID.Description: This field contains an identifier to designate the secondary target.

SEC_BE.Name: Basic Encyclopedia ID
SEC_BE.Description: This field contains the basic encyclopedia identifier of the secondary target, including the OSUFFIX (target designator).

RESVD001.Name: Reserved 1
RESVD001.Description: This value field is reserved for future use.
